convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, money management, and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Buy position closed when Color[1]<2 (downtrend signal detected)
Sell position closed when Color[1]>5 (uptrend signal detected)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a color-index buffer (buffer 1) from the custom indicator to determine trend direction. Color values >5 indicate uptrend (color zone), values <2 indicate downtrend. Entry requires the previous bar (SignalBar+1) to be in the extreme color zone AND the current signal bar (SignalBar) to have transitioned into that zone (e.g. Color[1]>5 AND Color[0]<6 for buy, meaning it just entered the upper color zone). SignalBar defaults to 1 meaning the logic reads from bars [1] and [2] (previous completed bars). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles to enable/disable each direction. Close signals are generated on the same bar as open signals - buy close when sell signal appears and vice versa (signal_reversal_close). The Recount flag handles failed CopyBuffer calls by retrying on next tick. LoadHistory ensures sufficient bar data is loaded before processing.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle must be either reimplemented in Python (Schaff MFI Trend Cycle oscillator) or its values pre-exported. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions which encapsulate position checking, order sending, and money management - these must be reimplemented. The MarginMode conditional sizing logic (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) needs careful translation. SL/TP are in points (1000 and 2000 respectively) - verify whether these need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10) depending on broker. The signal logic uses integer color index values from the indicator's buffer 1, not raw oscillator values, so the custom indicator must reproduce the exact color zone thresholds (>5 for bullish, <2 for bearish).
